title: Create the access policy and token

blocks.content: The third value is a Grafana Cloud Access Policy Token. Create an access policy with the `sigil:write` scope, add the `metrics:write`, `logs:write`, and `traces:write` scopes so the same token also serves traces and metrics in Milestone 7, then add a token to the policy.
Create the access policy with its four scopes.
Go to the access policy page at **Administration** > **Users and access** > **Cloud access policies**.

whenTrue.content:
Pop this guide out so it stays visible while the **Create new access policy** dialog is open.

Drag it aside if it sits on top of the dialog.

blocks.content: Open **Add scope**, type `sigil:write`, and select it.
blocks.hint: `sigil:write` is only listed after Agent Observability is enabled on the stack (Milestone 1).

blocks.content: In the scopes grid, select **Write** for **metrics**, **logs**, and **traces**.
The new policy appears in the list with its four scopes.

On the new policy, click **Add token**, give the token a name, and click **Create**. Copy the token now and paste it into your notes file as the third value.

Tokens start with `glc_`.
> **Warning:** The token is shown only once. Store it securely, for example in an environment variable or secret manager. If you lose it, add a new token to the policy.

whenTrue.content: Dock this guide back to the sidebar.
